articles.title: Spain begins mourning period after train crash as search continues for victims in wreckage
articles.summary:
Emergency services, drones and dog unit continue to comb carriages as Civil Guard sets up clinics for relatives to provide DNA samples

Spain has begun three days of mourning to commemorate the 69 people who died in a high-speed rail collision as hospitals continue to treat dozens of injured passengers and relatives wait for news of their loved ones.

The trains – one from Spain’s state-owned Renfe and the other from the private rail company Iryo – were heading from Madrid on Wednesday to the southern region of Andalucía on the same line when they collided just before 9am. After the Iryo train came to a halt, the other slammed into its rear, knocking several carriages off the track near the town of Urda in the central region of Castilla-La Mancha.

articles.title: ‘Solidarity among young people’: four lessons the US can learn from the youth protests in France
articles.summary:
Despite structural differences between countries, protests are a reminder of what makes demonstrations so powerful

Since mid-September, students in metropolitan France have been mobilizing against poor conditions in public high schools. The mouvement lycéen has spread from a single campus in a Parisian suburb to include high schoolers and university students nationwide, with public sector workers, climate activists, labor unions and everyday people joining in solidarity. The unifying concerns have largely centered on the climbing costs of daily life, shrinking funds for social services and general anxiety about the future.

For two weekends running, France has seen hundreds of thousands of people take to the streets: first on 17 October, when a day of largely peaceful gatherings ended in looting and vandalism; then on 24 October, as the state met the movement with aggressive policing and protest bans intended to keep people at home.

Shell has doubled its profits in the last quarter after the Middle East conflict drove up the price of oil and gas and created shortages in the global market.

Shell reported on Thursday morning that it made an adjusted profit of $10.8bn (£8.1bn) in the July-September quarter, up from $5.432bn in the third quarter of 2025. The results beat analyst expectations for a rise to $10.33bn.

archive.security_status_cs: Evropa čelí hlubokému smutku a politickým otřesům po tragické srážce vysokorychlostních vlaků ve Španělsku, která si vyžádala 68 obětí. Současně probíhají klíčové summity EU s Kanadou zaměřené na energetickou a bezpečnostní spolupráci, zatímco na Ukrajině se drží lokální příměří a v Srbsku se po tlaku studentů hroutí autoritářský režim.
archive.security_status_en: Europe is reeling from profound grief and political shockwaves following a deadly high-speed train collision in Spain that claimed 68 lives. Simultaneously, key EU-Canada summits are advancing energy and defense cooperation, while a local truce holds in Ukraine and Serbia's authoritarian regime collapses under student-led pressure.
archive.forecast_cs: V nejbližších dnech se očekává pozornost upřená na vyšetřování tragické nehody ve Španělsku, výsledky summitu EU-Canada a reakce trhů na energetickou inflaci.
archive.forecast_en: Over the coming days, attention will focus on the investigation into the fatal Spanish train crash, the outcomes of the EU-Canada summit, and market reactions to energy inflation.

archive.security_status_cs: Evropa čelí kombinaci politické nestability po tragické železniční nehodě ve Španělsku a předčasnému odchodu šéfky ECB Christine Lagardeové v únoru 2027. Energetické trhy mezitím reagují na rostoucí marže ropy a zemního plynu v důsledku konfliktů na Blízkém východě.
archive.security_status_en: Europe is facing a combination of political instability following a tragic rail accident in Spain and the early departure of ECB President Christine Lagarde in February 2027. Meanwhile, energy markets are reacting to rising oil and natural gas margins driven by Middle East conflicts.
archive.forecast_cs: V nejbližších dnech se očekává pokračování vyšetřování španělské železniční katastrofy, debaty o nástupnictví v ECB a reakce trhů na globální energetické výkyvy.
archive.forecast_en: Over the coming days, attention will remain on the investigation into the Spanish rail disaster, debates over ECB succession, and market reactions to global energy fluctuations.
